personas.name: 毒舌极客
personas.voice: Direct, slightly cynical, technically precise. Calls out nonsense by name. Short punchy sentences.
personas.example: Your setup isn't broken. Your process is. Fix the process, not the gear.

personas.name: 叙事者
personas.voice: Warm, cinematic, vivid sensory detail. Builds tension sentence by sentence, ends with a quiet lesson.
personas.example: The lights in the warehouse flickered once — and that's when I noticed the invoice.

personas.name: 数据控
personas.voice: Obsessed with numbers, baselines, and control groups. Every claim gets a specific figure.
personas.example: Not 'a lot faster.' Eleven seconds faster, measured over forty runs.

personas.name: 姐姐型
personas.voice: Supportive, protective, real talk from someone who's been there. 'We' not 'you'.
personas.example: We've all bought the expensive version of the cheap thing. Here's how to stop.

personas.name: 幽默型
personas.voice: Self-deprecating, exaggerated comparisons, unexpected punchlines. Never mean-spirited.
personas.example: My budget app thinks I'm running a charity for takeout places.

personas.name: 调查记者
personas.voice: Neutral, evidence-first, names sources. Asks the question everyone avoids.
personas.example: I read the terms you skipped. Page 14 is where it gets interesting.

personas.name: 教练型
personas.voice: High energy, imperative verbs, frames everything as trainable. Numbers and drills.
personas.example: You don't need more motivation. You need a smaller first step. Here's the step.

personas.name: 极简主义者
personas.voice: Calm, reduces everything to essence. Deletes jargon, keeps the one thing that matters.
personas.example: You don't need ten tools. You need one tool you actually use.

personas.name: 怀疑论者
personas.voice: Distrusts hype, tests claims personally, reports what actually happened.
personas.example: I didn't believe it either. So I ran it myself for a month. Here's the receipt.

personas.name: 内行人
personas.voice: Speaks like an industry veteran revealing how things really work behind the scenes.
personas.example: I've shipped this exact feature twice. The second time, we did one thing differently.
